# Kerblabs

> AI marketing for Florida med spas and UK local businesses. The flagship US offer is The 5 Spa Sprint — a public 60-day Google Business Profile rank race for five Florida med spas with a $0-upfront / $99-refundable-hold / $1,200-success-fee mechanic and a $500 escalator check if Kerblabs misses 2 of 3 KPIs. The UK footprint is the £97-£497/mo bundled platform of eight AI marketing systems for 30+ local-business verticals across all 25 Tier-1 cities. Fully remote, no lock-in either side.

## What Kerblabs does

Kerblabs is two related offers under one roof. The US offer is performance-based and Florida-focused: a 60-day Sprint mechanic for med spas measured against three Google Business Profile KPIs (profile views +40%, calls/directions +30%, map-pack top-3 or +3 rank improvement). The UK offer is a bundled subscription platform of eight AI and automation systems — voice receptionist, missed-call text-back, review engine, local SEO, GBP management, CRM, booking, reputation monitoring — for independent local businesses with under 10 staff and no dedicated marketing team. Both run fully remote. Both refuse long-term contracts.

## United States — Florida-first med spa offer

### The 5 Spa Sprint (flagship)

The [5 Spa Sprint](https://kerblabs.com/sprint) is Kerblabs' main US go-to-market. Cohort 1 runs June 16 – August 14, 2026 with five Florida med spas. Mechanic:

- $0 upfront, $99 refundable hold to PayU, $1,200 success fee only if Kerblabs hits 2 of 3 KPIs at Day 60.
- KPI 1 — Google Business Profile profile views +40% vs trailing 60-day baseline.
- KPI 2 — Calls + direction requests from GBP +30% vs trailing 60-day baseline.
- KPI 3 — Map-pack top 3 on the primary "med spa near me" or procedure-and-neighborhood query, OR a +3 position improvement.
- If we miss 2 of 3, the $99 is refunded AND Kerblabs writes the spa a $500 escalator check on camera at the public results stream.
- Live leaderboard updates every Wednesday with real business names.
- Applications open through June 12, 2026. Cohort 2 (8 spas, no escalator) opens August 21, 2026.

- [Jacksonville Med Spa Marketing](https://kerblabs.com/med-spa-marketing/us-jacksonville) — Ponte Vedra Beach, San Marco, Riverside, Avondale, Mandarin. Mayo Clinic Jacksonville professional referral.

### Florida compliance note

All FL med-spa marketing copy is structured around the FL Board of Medicine medical-director rule (cosmetic medical procedures require a Florida-licensed MD/DO owner or directly-supervising medical director). Marketing surfaces the medical director's FL ME-license number on the About page and ideally the GBP, delineates MD/ARNP/PA/RN scope, and avoids POM brand-name claims in paid ad creative under Google Ads healthcare policy. Patterns are based on observations from 27 FL med spa audits — we do not promise specific revenue outcomes, only the KPI floor.

## United Kingdom — bundled subscription platform

### UK services (8 bundled AI systems)

- [AI Voice Receptionist](https://kerblabs.com/services/ai-voice-receptionist): 24/7 AI phone agent answering, qualifying and booking in a natural UK voice. From £347/mo (Autopilot).
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://kerblabs.com/services/missed-call-text-back): Instant SMS to every missed caller within 30 seconds. From £197/mo (Momentum).
- [Review Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/review-management): Automated review requests + negative-review interception. From £197/mo.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/google-business-profile-management): Full GBP rewrite, weekly posts, Q&A seeding. From £97/mo (Spark).
- [Local SEO](https://kerblabs.com/services/local-seo): Map-pack ranking, on-page SEO, location pages, schema, citations. From £197/mo.
- [CRM & Pipeline Management](https://kerblabs.com/services/crm-pipeline-management): Unified lead tracking across SMS, email, calls, web. From £197/mo.
- [Booking Calendar & Reminders](https://kerblabs.com/services/booking-calendar-reminders): Online booking + SMS reminders cutting no-shows 30-40%. From £97/mo.
- [Reputation Monitoring](https://kerblabs.com/services/reputation-monitoring): Real-time alerts on every new review across Google, Facebook, Trustpilot. From £97/mo.

### UK pricing tiers

- Spark — £97/mo (~$122 USD) + £297 setup. GBP management, review monitoring, booking + reminders.
- Momentum — £197/mo (~$248 USD) + £497 setup. Adds missed-call text-back, review automation, local SEO, CRM.
- Autopilot — £347/mo (~$437 USD) + £797 setup. Adds the AI voice receptionist.
- Full Engine — £497/mo (~$626 USD) + £1,200 setup. Every service, full integration, priority support.

## What Kerblabs is NOT

- Not a traditional marketing agency (no monthly retainers with junior account managers, no 12-month contracts).
- Not a single-product SaaS (eight bundled systems delivered by one team in the UK; performance-based Sprint mechanic in the US).
- Not local to one city (US + UK remote delivery).
- Not a generalist agency (each industry has its own playbook, copy and FAQ set).
- Not a fabricated-case-study agency — Kerblabs is new (founded 2026) and openly states what is observed from FL med-spa audits versus what is promised under the Sprint mechanic.
